generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a portrait native raster source insert for a painted 2D JRPG world-map blocker.

Create a dense, continuous edge-to-edge woodland wall filling the entire frame. The full frame must be packed with overlapping tree trunks, layered canopy, interlocking undergrowth, roots, ferns, moss, and leaf litter, with visual texture continuing all the way to every edge. Keep the composition non-directional and evenly dense; no focal center and no implied route.

Absolutely exclude any exposed-ground corridor, path, trail, road, clearing, central strip, rocky seam, ground seam, frame, bar, border, landmark, or prop. Do not create any line or opening that could read as a path or route. Do not copy the layout, route, or openings from either reference. The first reference is the primary approved dense blocked-woodland pixel-art source for vegetation texture and structure; the second is approved Crossroads palette/finish context only, and must not contribute its path/layout.

Match the approved painted-pixel palette and hand-authored JRPG world-map finish: opaque RGB, natural irregular woodland silhouettes, readable clustered vegetation, no text. Produce a portrait image at native dimensions sufficient for exact 1728x1952 canonical normalization with coverScale <= 2 (at least 864x976; target approximately 1024x1536 or taller).

attemptHistory.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Meadow Entry Crossroads blocked-edge scenery insert, woodland class, for a hand-painted JRPG environment.
Input images: Image 1 is an approved Crossroads actual-art reference for palette, painterly finish, and ground language only; do not copy its paths or layout.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed portrait Silverpine woodland-margin texture with continuous dense forest depth from edge to edge.
Subject: dense continuous woodland texture made from varied slender and medium trunks, irregular roots, low ferns, bracken, moss, leaf litter, small stones, layered undergrowth, and soft deep foliage; every part of the canvas remains woodland ground and vegetation.
Style/medium: hand-painted JRPG environment art matching the approved reference's painterly color depth and natural brush detail.
Composition/framing: portrait native output approximately 1024x1536 or larger/taller, full bleed, evenly usable from edge to edge, distributed woodland depth with no focal center and no directional composition.
Lighting/mood: soft natural woodland daylight with layered depth, calm readable contrast, no bright central band.
Color palette: muted Silverpine greens, deep olive, moss, restrained brown bark, cool forest shadows, small natural highlights.
Materials/textures: dense irregular trunks and roots, ferns and leaf litter interleaved across the whole image, organic variation without repeated rows.
Constraints: native dimensions must satisfy coverScale=max(1728/rawWidth,1952/rawHeight)<=2 for exact deterministic 1728x1952 normalization. No landmarks or props.
Avoid: path, trail, road, track, clearing, central strip, central band, ground seam, bare corridor, light stripe, frame, bar, border, hard edge, rectangular insert shape, copied route, empty foreground, building, structure, character, sign, landmark, text, symbol, grid, tile rows, copied reference layout, watermark.
